statement: Is every connected edge-transitive bipartite graph Sidorenko?

source.reference: Sidorenko (2020): weakly norming graphs are edge-transitive; Kral, Martins, Pach and Wrochna (2019): toroidal grids are edge-transitive and not weakly norming; Conlon and Lee (2017, Section 6) conjecture a characterization of weakly norming graphs through edge-transitivity.

observation: Edge-transitive graphs are biregular, so the counterexample's pinning step cannot apply; the known edge-transitive graphs that are not weakly norming (toroidal grids) are Sidorenko through product theorems.
neighbours: Is every connected biregular bipartite graph Sidorenko?
notes: Narrower than the biregular candidate and without an established consequence beyond the class.

disposition.reason: Compare with the other candidates of the slate.
